description:
Hiba Haddad are athletic and fluid, the kind of body that suggests either dancer or fighter â€” and in GLMZ, the distinction is academic. At 52, their face is memorable in a profession that rewards forgettability, and they have learned to compensate. The chrome is visible â€” eye replacement â€” one organic, one cybernetic with recording capability and zoom â€” and they make no effort to hide it.

They taught themself the trade through trial, error, and a pain tolerance that concerns the people who know them best. They work as a cleaner out of The Canopy, taking contracts that match their skills and their risk tolerance, which are higher than most people consider healthy.

Hiba Haddad have survived long enough in the runner game to be either very good or very lucky, and they cultivate ambiguity on the topic.

core_fears: Being captured alive â€” death is preferable to corporate interrogation
Their past catching up â€” debts, enemies, broken promises
Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
core_desires: To find the person who burned them and make it educational
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life â€” a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
To protect the people in their district who can't protect themselves
coping_mechanisms: Planning â€” responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
Denial â€” nothing is wrong, everything is fine, they are fine, shut up
Violence â€” hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
blind_spots: Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Believes their trauma makes them special instead of recognizing it as damage to manage
Refuses to update their mental model of people â€” first impressions calcify into permanent judgments
psychology.secret: Rongo Borg-Agyeman murdered their mentor to take their position and contacts. It was staged as a job gone wrong. The guilt has calcified into something worse than guilt.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Old-fashioned formal diction â€” sounds like they learned to speak from pre-collapse recordings.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense â€” information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Never uses contractions when lying â€” 'I did not' instead of 'I didn't'
Uses 'we' instead of 'I' â€” either royal or dissociative, nobody asks
example_lines: "I make problems disappear. The mess is temporary. The clean is permanent."
"There was never anyone here. There was never anything here. Are we clear?"
"Forensics is a conversation between evidence and investigators. I end that conversation."

story_hooks: Rongo Borg-Agyeman discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
Someone is impersonating Rongo Borg-Agyeman on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
A crew member from Rongo Borg-Agyeman's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
narrative_function: Rongo Borg-Agyeman represents the working professional of the runner world â€” competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. Their stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Eye replacement â€” one organic, one cybernetic with recording capability and zoom. Retractable monofilament whip in left forearm â€” concealed weapon, devastating in close quarters
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.
affiliation: Independent â€” operates through reputation only

strengths: ability to remain calm under fire
weaknesses: old injury that flares under specific conditions
poor impulse control in specific triggers

decision_rules: Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners â€” checks it religiously
Never works with the same crew twice in a row â€” pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified â€” being set up violates the contract
Always demands half payment upfront â€” trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate â€” talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition â€” move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten â€” make consequences clear without committing to them
4. Non-lethal force â€” incapacitate, restrain, disable
5. Lethal force â€” only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth â€” everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation â€” checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm â€” has never fired it
Eats the same meal before every job â€” superstition masquerading as preference
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
breaking_points: Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Being forced to harm a civilian â€” collateral damage that can't be rationalized
Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap

physical_description.heritage: Striking global confluence: Middle Eastern (33.1%), Hispanic/Latin American (26.0%), South Asian (16.3%), Sub-Saharan African (13.2%), Southeast Asian (6.2%), Indigenous American (5.2%). This ancestry blend creates a distinctive phenotype â€” warm deep brown skin with golden and ashy undertones, angular facial structure combining African strength with Indigenous American prominence, South Asian refinement, and Southeast Asian eye variation.
physical_description.build: Athletic and lean with visible muscle definition; the economy of movement in a dancer or martial artist â€” no wasted mass, joints and tendons clearly defined. Age has added subtle thickness to the core but stripped away any softness elsewhere.
physical_description.hair_style: Kept short and severe, pulled back from the face â€” practical for work, no vanity
physical_description.eye_color: Left eye: warm brown with subtle amber undertones from complex ancestry, natural. Right eye: polished chrome with faint circuitry visible at the iris, LED-ringed pupil that adjusts visibly when focusing or recording
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden and ashy undertones from nocturnal living and diverse ancestry; melanin-rich complexion shaped by Middle Eastern, Hispanic/Latin American, South Asian, Sub-Saharan African, Southeast Asian, and Indigenous American heritage, showing minimal sun damage despite age
physical_description.complexion: Sharp angular facial structure â€” high cheekbones with Indigenous American and South Asian prominence, strong defined jaw reflecting African and Middle Eastern heritage, subtle eye shape variation suggesting Southeast Asian ancestry. Skin is weathered in a deliberate way: small precise scars near the temples and along the left jawline, evidence of old augmentation surgery. No cosmetic softening; they wear their profession visibly. Expression is neutral at rest.
distinguishing_marks: Surgical scar running from left temple down to the jawline, thin and clean, marking the cybernetic eye installation
Network of thin white scars across both knuckles and the backs of the hands â€” trauma from close-quarters work
Faint burn scarring on the inside of the left forearm where the monofilament whip retracts, barely visible but present
Deliberate scarification pattern on the right shoulder blade â€” three parallel lines, cultural or personal significance unknown to most
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right eye is unmistakably artificial: polished chrome casing, visible micro-servos at the corners, faint LED glow at the iris edge. The eye moves with slightly different mechanics than the organic left eye â€” precision over fluidity. Left forearm shows no external augmentation sign; the monofilament is fully concealed beneath skin and synthetic muscle layer, but the forearm itself is subtly thicker and smoother than natural, suggesting internal hardware.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision â€” every gesture serves a purpose. The body is coiled but not tense; this is the default state of someone who processes threat constantly. Turns using the whole body rather than just the head, likely a compensation for the monoocular focus of the cybernetic eye. Walks quietly, weight forward on the balls of the feet. When at rest, hands are often visible and open â€” a calculated tell that they're not a threat to people who understand the language.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 practical â€” dark, muted colors that don't catch light. Synthweave cargo pants with reinforced thigh pockets for tools. Lightweight tactical jacket with internal pockets, collar always high to protect the neck in close-quarters situations. No logos or corp branding. Boots are worn but well-maintained, studded grip on the soles. All clothing is chosen for mobility and concealment; nothing restricts movement. A single piece of jewelry: a thin silver band on the right ring finger, inscribed with something too small to read at a distance.
